title: Merge Getaway
description: A 3D car-merging getaway: the police are after you, so merge cars of the same colour to accelerate and escape. Artsiom Trubchyk's Ludum Dare 50 compo entry.
author: Artsiom Trubchyk (aglitchman)
controls: A/D or left/right steer; M toggles music; R restarts.
credits: Built on Scene3D by Indiesoft LLC (MIT). Models made in SideFX Houdini, 2D art in Affinity Designer, music in Bandlab, by the author.
notes: defos (fullscreen toggle), Screenshot, clipboard and the game's own LD50 HTML5 glue are desktop or browser extensions a cart cannot use; the Lua guards its two defos calls. pointer_lock is replaced by cart-ext/pointer_lock. scene3d is pinned to its latest commit (3b7048a) for Defold 1.14; its three shaders with sampler2D parameters are replaced under overrides/.
